entities.title: Logging is recognised by names, and calls in its arguments are not side effects
entities.summary: A statement counts as logging when its receiver and method names look like a logger, Debug, Trace or a span; only assignments, increments, decrements and awaits in it count as side effects.
entities.impact: A logging call whose arguments call a method that changes state (for example _logger.LogInformation("{N}", Next())) is hidden with that call, and a non-logging object named like a logger with a Log… method is hidden too. Logging through other names stays visible.
